questions.question: A boat travels 33 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 1 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 33/3 = 11 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 11 − 1 = 10 km/h.

questions.question: A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/30 = 50/600. Time = 600/50 = 12 days.

questions.question: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 41 days?
questions.explanation: 41 mod 7 = 6; Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 13th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 13th letter = M; 13 + 2 = 15th letter = O.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (9, 729), (5, 125), (7, 342)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 7³ = 343, not 342.

questions.question: In a row of 45 students, Ravi is 32nd from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 45 − 32 + 1 = 14.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 7, 13, 22, 34, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 15, so 34 + 15 = 49.

questions.question: If STAR is coded as UVCT, how is CAT coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to CAT gives ECV.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 2:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 2:00 the angle is 2 × 30° = 60°.

questions.question: A person walks 5 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 9 + 3 × 3.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 8, 16, 32, ?

questions.question: Complete the series: C, F, I, L, ?

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 17, 4, 7, 23
questions.explanation: 7, 17, 23 are prime numbers; 4 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 3rd from the right end of the English alphabet?

questions.explanation: 36 mod 7 = 1; Friday + 1 = Saturday.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 8, 12, 17, 23, ?

questions.question: If RAIN is coded as UDLQ, how is TREE coded?
